title: Operations Home
body: Welcome to the WFS Operations space. Start here for carrier vetting SOPs and dispatch runbooks.

title: Carrier Vetting SOP
body: Standard operating procedure for vetting new carriers. Check FMCSA authority, insurance certs, safety rating, and run them through Carrier411 before booking.

title: Automotive Parts Carrier Refresh
body: Q4 2026 carrier vetting refresh for the Cumberland Auto Parts and Tri-State accounts. Re-confirm insurance, MC numbers, and lane history on every preferred carrier.

title: Dispatch Runbook
body: Day to day dispatch steps. Confirm pickup, send rate con, track and trace, collect signed BOL, then hand off to bookkeeping for invoicing.

title: Freight Software Evaluation
body: Notes comparing FreightFlow Pro and RoutePoint Logistics Suite. Leaning toward RoutePoint for the TMS upgrade. Demo notes and pricing inside.

title: Compliance Home
body: Welcome to the Compliance space. DOT notes broker authority and the mentorship program live here.

title: DOT Compliance Notes
body: Running notes from the quarterly DOT compliance webinars. Broker bond, surety, and carrier monitoring requirements. Next webinar Oct 23 2026.

title: TN Freight Mentorship Program
body: Outline for the autumn mentorship cohort run with Keith Burgess. Curriculum covers broker authority, pricing lanes, and carrier relations.

title: Preferred Carrier List
body: Master list of preferred carriers by lane. Ridgeline Trucking, Cumberland Gap Carriers, Volunteer Logistics Carriers, and Smoky Mountain Freight Lines. Insurance expiration column flags anything inside 60 days.

title: Rate Con and BOL Templates
body: Standard rate confirmation and bill of lading templates. Use the DocuSign envelope flow for carrier signatures before dispatch releases the load.

title: Client Onboarding Checklist
body: Steps to onboard a new shipper. Credit check, signed broker-shipper agreement, lane profile, and billing setup. Hand the signed agreement to Dale for the file.

title: Agricultural Products Lane Notes
body: Lane notes for Valley Grain Cooperative and Appalachian Ag Producers. Seasonal grain runs peak late summer. Watch reefer capacity into the Midwest corridor.

title: Building Materials Lane Notes
body: Lane notes for Smoky Mountain Building Supply. Flatbed and tarping requirements. Confirm securement and permits on any oversize loads.

title: Brand Onboarding Plan
body: 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for Brand Whitaker, junior associate. Shadow dispatch, learn carrier vetting, then run his own small book of accounts.

title: RoutePoint Demo Notes
body: Detailed notes from the RoutePoint Logistics Suite demo. Load board integration and carrier monitoring look solid. Pricing quote attached for Wayne to review.

title: FreightFlow Pro Demo Notes
body: Notes from the FreightFlow Pro demo. Cleaner reporting but weaker carrier vetting tools. Leaning RoutePoint after comparing the two.

title: Invoicing and Collections SOP
body: Bookkeeping flow from signed BOL to invoice to payment. Net 30 terms standard. Dale follows up on anything past 45 days and flags it to Floyd.

title: Broker Bond and Surety Notes
body: Notes on the BMC-84 broker bond renewal and surety requirements. FMCSA license #28471. Renewal handled through the agent each year.

title: Carrier Monitoring Procedure
body: Procedure for ongoing carrier monitoring. Re-check FMCSA authority and safety rating monthly. Pull Carrier411 alerts and log any out-of-service flags.

title: Mentorship Cohort Curriculum
body: Week by week curriculum for the autumn mentorship cohort with Keith Burgess. Sessions on authority, lane pricing, carrier relations, and claims handling.

title: DOT Webinar Schedule 2026
body: Quarterly DOT compliance webinar schedule for 2026. Next session Oct 23 2026. Bren sends calendar invites to the whole team a week ahead.
